description.zh: MapRun 运行时的并发限制。单账户配额默认最大300，可以通过配额中心提升。
description.en: The concurrency limit for the MapRun runtime. The default quota for a single account is 300. You can request a quota increase in Quota Center.

description.zh: MapRun 名称，当 Execution 中发起 MapRun 执行后，会产生 MapRunStarted 事件，MapRunName 可以从 MapRunStarted 事件的 Output 中获取。
description.en: Name of the MapRun. Retrieve this value from the output of the `MapRunStarted` event.

description.zh: 允许失败的 Item 数量的最大值
description.en: The maximum number of failed items that are allowed.

description.zh: 允许失败的 Item 数量占全部 Item 数量的最大百分比。取值区间为 0 - 100。
description.en: The maximum percentage of failed items that are allowed. Valid range: 0 to 100.
